name: Tiefling Assassin's Blade

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus : +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Keen
effects.tooltip: Keen : Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification .

effects.name: Wounding
effects.tooltip: Wounding : A wounding weapon deals 1 point of Constitution damage from blood loss when it hits a creature. Creatures immune to critical hits are immune to the Constitution damage dealt by this weapon.

effects.name: Poison
effects.tooltip: Poison : This weapon is dripping with poison. It deals an additional 1 to 6 poison damage on a successful hit.

flavor_text: This shortsword is viciously serrated, increasing the likelyhood of dealing critical damage to an enemy. The blade is coated with a potent toxin, inflaming any wounds inflicted by this weapon.

source.raw: Three-Barrel Cove (heroic) , Ithun Orenah 's chest (Rare Encounter)
